extracted.intended_audience: potential clients, current and prospective employees, and partners of WGA Consulting Engineers
extracted.subtask_description: Company homepage copy outlining WGA's service areas, team philosophy, core values, and service-quality commitments for clients and job seekers. Focuses on what the firm promises to deliver and what it expects of/for its people.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best in class for the people we serve.
rubrics_metrics.description: Best in class for the people we serve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioning statement/quality promise that the firm aims to deliver top-tier service to its clients and communities. Used as an overarching performance expectation for projects and client interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert Solutions in Civil Engineering, Environmental Consulting, and Construction Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Expert Solutions in Civil Engineering, Environmental Consulting, and Construction Services
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the core disciplines in which the firm claims technical expertise; implies a criterion of domain competence and professional-level delivery in these areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Our greatest asset is our diversified team of engineers, designers, creative thinkers, and problem solvers.
rubrics_metrics.description: Our greatest asset is our diversified team of engineers, designers, creative thinkers, and problem solvers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes staff diversity of skills and roles as a quality metric; suggests hiring/retention and team composition are viewed as drivers of organizational performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Empowering team members to be their best
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to empowering all team members to be the best they can be, to have the freedom to think outside the box, and the ability to grow their skill sets and careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational guideline for internal culture: staff should be given autonomy, opportunities for professional development, and encouragement of creative problem solving. Implies recruitment/management practices that support growth and autonomy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide value through creative and cost-effective design solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: From high-rise buildings to small developments, we strive to provide value through creative and cost-effective design solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service-quality criterion focused on balancing creativity and cost-efficiency in design work; indicates expectations for proposals and delivered designs to demonstrate both innovation and budget-consciousness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experience with both governmental and private entities
rubrics_metrics.description: WGA has equal experience with both governmental and private entities which has allowed us to gain a unique perspective on client expectations and hone our capabilities to accomplish a project on time and within budget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims breadth of client experience as a quality factor; implies that familiarity with public and private sector processes contributes to better project management and meeting client expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accomplish a project on time and within budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Accomplish a project on time and within budget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clear performance metric for project delivery and client satisfaction; used as an evaluative criterion for project success and firm reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliver innovative engineering solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: We deliver innovative engineering solutions and we pride ourselves in providing our clients with an extraordinary, consistent, and personal service experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines innovation with service expectations: solutions should be technically novel or improved while service must be consistent, exceptional, and personalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide an extraordinary, consistent, and personal service experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide our clients with an extraordinary, consistent, and personal service experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Client service standard emphasizing exceptional quality, reliability (consistency), and personalization; indicates how client interactions and account management should be measured.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accountability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core value; implies responsibility for delivering on commitments, ownership of outcomes, and transparent communication with clients and team members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core value; implies professional conduct, consideration for colleagues and clients, and inclusive behavior in project and workplace interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Empowerment (core value)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core value reinforcing the cultural expectation that employees are supported to take initiative, innovate, and develop professionally (distinct but related to the earlier empowerment-of-team-members criterion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Efficiency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core value; implies operational and design processes should minimize waste, optimize resources, and deliver results in a timely, cost-effective manner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attitude
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core value; suggests that positive, proactive, and client-focused demeanors are valued and measured in staff performance and client interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effort
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core value; indicates that dedication and hard work are core expectations for staff and are part of how success and cultural fit are judged.
